description: A placeholder declaring its column's own type takes the column override wherever it is compared with, listed against, bounds or is assigned to the column, so json.Number and []byte values bind through every database/sql path (exec, copyfrom and batch rows, comparisons, an IN list, BETWEEN, a Nullable(IPv4) comparison and an ALTER TABLE UPDATE) and round-trip. The addresses are read back through toString, since the driver hands database/sql an IPv4 value as a net.IP, which it cannot store in a json.Number
